questions.q: In wealth management, what is linear regression useful for?
options: Understanding how a fund performs relative to a benchmark
Detecting gender bias in written text
Predicting which clothes will sell next season
questions.explain: Regression relates a fund's returns to a benchmark; multiple regression can add further risk factors.
questions.evidence: Linear regression is a valuable tool for understanding how a fund performs relative to some benchmark.

questions.q: How did one company use machine learning to manage hospital readmissions?
options: It used a genetic algorithm to design new wards
It translated patient records with NLP
It ran linear regression on drug prices
It clustered readmissions to find groups that may share a common cause
questions.explain: Clustering groups similar readmissions so analysts can look for a shared cause.
questions.evidence: discover groups of readmissions that may share a common cause

questions.q: In the clinical-trials study, which algorithm produced a classifier that distinguishes between groups of drugs?
questions.explain: The researchers used a random forest classifier to predict the odds of clinical-trial outcomes.
questions.evidence: they were able to use random forest to produce a classifier that is able to distinguish between groups of drugs
